description: Extract timed subtitle segments and plain-text transcript for any public YouTube video or Short in any available language.

lang.description: Preferred 2-letter subtitle language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de, ja). Defaults to en.

video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or full youtube.com/watch?v=... / youtu.be/... URL.

name: youtube_transcript

isAutoGenerated.description: Whether the caption track is auto-generated.

segments.description: Timestamped subtitle cues (text, startSec, durationSec, endSec).

meta.description: Gateway execution metadata including request ID, cache tier, and credits charged.

title: Get YouTube Transcript
